content: {"like":["High production quality in period dramas like *Charles & Camilla – Whatever Love Means*","Strong, believable female leads in contemporary family dramas such as *A Place to Call Home*","Authentic, emotionally resonant performances by veteran actors in romantic dramas, e.g., Harrison Ford in *The Age of Adaline*","Well-crafted, nuanced relationships in character-driven dramas, exemplified by *Sidney Chambers* stories","Subtle, compassionate portrayals of complex characters in modern dramas like *McAdams*"],"dislike":["Unrealistic, exaggerated character behavior in romantic comedies and dramas, e.g., Charles’s wimpy portrayal","Forced, rapid relationship development in contemporary dramas, such as *Sidney Chambers*","Lack of realism and relatable protagonists in fantasy or time-travel films, like *The Age of Adaline*","Gratuitous sex and violence in action or period pieces, e.g., trench‑bloodbath series","Overly polished, unrealistic settings that detract from authenticity, such as the stylized period costumes in certain series"]}
